contentNote.title: Content and updates
contentNote.purpose: We use AI for research, writing, and maintenance. Our aim is to keep these guides useful as rules and products change through ongoing verification and revision.
contentNote.sources: Key facts cite their sources. Prices, policies, and eligibility are checked against the relevant official material. Practitioner accounts identify their authors and context so you can assess the original account and its relevance.
contentNote.verification: Verification dates record completed source checks; the text and change history describe their scope. Rules may change afterward. Illustration and layout edits do not automatically refresh verification dates.
contentNote.visuals: This site’s scene illustrations are created with AI to support the explanation. Teaching cases and demos use labeled example data. Actual procedures and results identify their sources and the scope of verification.
